title: A faster stage has a smaller request effect
caption: Illustrative serial request. A 200 µs baseline contains 80 µs of projection and 120 µs of other work. Halving only the projection gives 160 µs. Making it instantaneous leaves 120 µs.

title: The lower ideal floor changes with batch
caption: Illustrative one-pass FP16 projection. At batch 1, compute machine A has a 67.14 µs floor and bandwidth machine B has 33.57 µs — B wins. At batch 256, A has an 85.90 µs floor and B has 171.80 µs — A wins. Compare machines within a batch: batch 256 does 256 times as much work. These optimistic bounds do not establish measured latency.

title: Lower power can spend more energy per result
caption: Illustrative whole-system averages over matched steady intervals: system C draws 200 W at 1,000 results/s (0.20 J/result). System D draws 150 W at 500 results/s (0.30 J/result). The output and quality must be comparable.
